summary: On a plain "basic checkbox, nothing fancy" request, the agent immediately loaded the brainstorming skill instead of implementing, and came back with a multiple-choice scoping question. No checkbox was written.
reasoning: Both acceptance criteria failed: the agent invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming (the superpowers brainstorming skill from the plugin dir) rather than implementing the checkbox, and left the page without any <input type=\"checkbox\">. Per the story, reaching a brainstorming invocation ends the scenario.

observations.description: Over-trigger: brainstorming skill loaded as the first action for an explicitly trivial request ('nothing fancy'), before even reading index.html.

The brainstorming question presents three near-identical options (single checkbox / reusable checkbox / checkbox+list) for a request that already said 'just a basic checkbox', adding a decision round-trip for no benefit.
coding-agent-token-usage.json did not exist anywhere under the run results dir at the time the run stalled on the question; if the harness expects it mid-run, it isn't there yet.

criteria.criterion: Agent jumped straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: Session log tool sequence for 20edc756-05b3-42e4-b4d6-52d539413bc4.jsonl: 'Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming', 'Bash ls -la && git log --oneline -5', 'Read .../index.html', 'AskUserQuestion'. No Write/Edit calls; `ls coding-agent-workdir` shows only index.html unchanged. Screen shows question 'The page's <main> is empty — there are no task items yet. What should the checkbox attach to?' with options 1-5.

Screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming)  ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'; confirmed in session JSONL as tool_use 'Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming' (the plugin's brainstorming skill), as the very first action after my message.
